definitions.explanation: A person who cooks as a profession, especially one skilled in preparing food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{料理人|りょうりにん}だ。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{料理人|りょうりにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧だ。
examples.english: The chef at that restaurant has a reputation for being skilled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{料理人|りょうりにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that becoming a top-class chef requires many years of training.

notes:
{料理人|りょうりにん} refers to someone who cooks professionally. It has a traditional, artisan feel and is often used for Japanese cuisine chefs.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧: chef (Western cuisine, head of kitchen)
- ⟦コック→コック：05063_kokku⟧: cook (Western cuisine, from Dutch "kok")
- ⟦{板前|いたまえ}→板前：13118_itamae⟧: Japanese cuisine chef (works at the counter)
- ⟦{調理師|ちょうりし}→調理師：16099_chourishi⟧: licensed cook (official qualification title)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{料理人|りょうりにん}: a skilled cook
- ⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{料理人|りょうりにん}: a first-rate chef
- {料理人|りょうりにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aspire to be a chef
